title: Vintage Le Creuset Cast Iron Plates – Set of 2 (Orange Enamel, Made in France)
description:
Set of 2 small oven plates in enameled cast iron by Le Creuset, marked “Made in France” (Nr. 3). Classic orange exterior with cream interior.
Ideal for individual dishes (gratins, desserts). Known for excellent heat distribution.
Condition: gowod vintage condition with light signs of use.
